svg.aria-label: hermes-parallel-followups. Two drop-in patches for the Nous Research Hermes gateway: follow-up messages sent to a busy session stay separate, and safe, self-contained follow-ups can run in parallel. Shown as one long busy turn on its own lane while separate follow-ups run beside it on two more lanes.
